title: Curvature-gated slope dynamics: level-orthogonal steepener/flattener states on the official par curve

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no price/yield signal arithmetic, and no measurement that the D2/I stages will run. The level-slope-curvature decomposition named here is a DECLARATION of what D2/I will compute; it is not computed in this file, and no descriptive statistic of any curve series appears here. Structural facts cited are read from committed P0/P1/P2 artifacts only.

mechanism.narrative: Condition on the SHAPE of the official par curve, never its level. The declared participant is late and mechanical: index-tracking and liability-driven mandates must hold whatever duration weights their benchmark carries and may rebalance only at period boundaries, so their response to curve-shape dislocations is delayed and directional in shape terms rather than level terms. The proposed state crosses two symbolic shape coordinates: a slope regime (steepening versus flattening behaviour of the curve) and a curvature bucket (belly rich versus cheap against the wings), both computed at D2/I from a level-slope-curvature decomposition of the official curve with the LEVEL factor explicitly removed before any state is formed. The economic claim: slope persistence versus mean-reversion is state-dependent on curvature. When the belly is dislocated, slope moves are driven by late, mechanical rebalancing flow that cannot act immediately, so slope changes persist; when the belly is fair, slope variation is noise that mean-reverts. Execution is a paired-leg ETP spread across duration buckets (which bucket pairs is symbolic until D2/S), deliberately structured so the position is a shape position rather than a duration bet. If the declared shape state is secretly yield-level beta in disguise, the mandatory level-vs-shape decomposition control out-earns the anchor and the proposal dies by its own battery; that admission is part of the proposal.

forced_participant.who: index-tracking and liability-driven mandates (the LATE participant)
forced_participant.why_late: they must track benchmark weights and may only rebalance at period boundaries or mandate reviews, so their response to a shape dislocation arrives after the dislocation appears, mechanically and in size
forced_participant.forced_counterparty_flow: the dealer community intermediating the mandates' late rebalancing must warehouse the interim exposure, which transmits the shape dislocation into the paired-leg pricing the proposal conditions on

mechanism.information_source: the official S5 par-yield curve's cross-tenor SHAPE (level-orthogonalized slope and curvature coordinates, computed at D2/I); no policy or survey data, no ETP price input inside the state
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: shape state q(t) = (slope regime bucket) x (curvature bucket) from the level-orthogonalized decomposition of the official curve at the state session; decomposition basis, bucket cuts and leg-pair mapping are SYMBOLIC here and freeze at D2/S selection, never after

decision_rule_family: cross-sectional curve-shape state bucketing with fixed thresholds to be frozen at selection; state = slope-regime x curvature bucket on the level-orthogonalized curve shape; position = paired-leg ETP spread across duration buckets with direction by frozen sign convention; all parameters (decomposition basis, bucket thresholds, leg pairs, holding) symbolic until D2/S, never tuned after any measurement

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the anchor's state is formed AFTER removing the level coordinate from the curve decomposition, and its execution is a paired-leg spread across duration buckets rather than an outright duration position; the level factor itself is traded as a paired KILLER control on the same grid, so a re-clocked level form is executed against by construction.
